title: 第11章 花儿的克星
slug: 花千骨全本免费-花千骨最新章节列表
content_zh:
“啊，什么？”糖宝爬到一朵桃花里舔着里面的仙汁蜜液，香甜的晕晕乎乎。
“我可以碰花了！我可以碰花了！！没有枯萎，一点都没有枯萎呢！”花千骨突然反应过来，双脚颤抖的抱住面前相比它的肉肉身体显得巨大的花瓣，脸儿在上面蹭来蹭去，柔柔的桃花瓣儿，绸缎一样的光滑而美丽。花千骨兴奋的打个滚儿，用花瓣被子一样把自己全身上下都裹了起来，好香，好舒服。
“你以前不能碰花么？”
“当然啦，不然我怎么叫花千骨，我生来就是花儿的克星。从来没有一朵花能在我手里完好如初的。为什么呢？为什么呢？”
“我想是天水滴或者那个勾玉的关系吧，特别是那个勾玉，看似普通，灵力却竟然比天水滴还要强上许多倍。你身上本来有一股很吸引妖魔鬼怪的气味，全被那个给屏蔽了。”
“啊？怪不得至从和朗哥哥分开，就再也没有以前那么多烦人的小鬼来缠我！”花千骨欣喜的从这朵花上爬到那朵花上。
林中的人渐渐多了起来，桌上放满了琼浆玉液，仙果佳肴，看得糖宝口水都快掉下去。
“你说我纵身一跳，跳到下面桌子上放的蟠桃上，会不会被发现？”
“不但会被发现，说不定还被仙人一起吃到肚子里去。”花千骨哈哈的笑，“要来多少仙人啊？怎么设了那么多座位？”
“天底下有名无名的仙人多着呢，不过能够出席天宴的倒也不多，道行厉害的大部分都在这了。除了各仙派掌门必到之外，一些名头响亮的散仙，王母都会下帖邀约。如今昆仑由王母主掌，加起来，来的也有个四五百吧。”
不一会儿钟鸣鼎盛，仙乐大作，悠悠的众仙进场开始入座。
各式各样的仙人都有，超凡脱俗的，美艳绝伦的，仙风道骨的，老态龙钟的，凶神恶煞的，一时间花千骨看得眼花缭乱，口干舌燥。除了最上面坐的是玉皇和王母能够识别的出来，其他的一概不知。
糖宝一一跟她介绍着。
“那边坐的是蓬莱三仙，福禄寿三星。穿红衣，留着小胡子，色咪咪盯着众仙女看，笑得很淫荡的那个是财神爷，旁边埋头贪杯的那个是福神，须发皆白，身边站着个童子的那个是寿星南极仙翁。”
“那边分别是崂山，天山，太白山，王屋山等各派的掌门。可惜茅山清虚道长不在了……”
“哪个是崂山掌门？”花千骨伸起脖子望，她还要帮林随意给他师父带话的。
“那边那棵树下，白头发，眉头紧缩闭眼静坐的那个，看见没有？”
“哦，看见了！”
“恩，那边的应该好认，多是佛门的各位菩萨，左边素衣光头的那些是十八罗汉，再往后一点是美音，梵音，天鼓，颂德，广目等十八伽蓝，你注意看妙叹，她是生得最美的一个，和嫦娥有得一拼，长得最奇怪的那个是雷音。”
“再往东边那几桌是二十诸天，他们的仙法都是一等一的厉害，脾气也挺火爆，一般人都不敢太招惹。”

“那边在对弈的是南斗六星君和北斗七星君。十三个人凑在一起，每次有机会聚在一起都是不分昼夜的下棋，而且是十三人同时下的超强联盟混战，他们的棋子都是天上的星星，可以锻炼出世上最好的兵器。”
“另外那边高声喧哗，好像在吵架一样的是四海的龙王。”
“啊？居然有个女的？好漂亮！”花千骨看着那么多惊世骇俗的天人的脸，开始有点审美疲劳了，可是仍然对那个爽快大笑又不失女子妩媚姿态的红发龙王感到惊艳。
“恩，里面最能喝，最厉害，也最漂亮的一个，新上任的北海龙王。”
“前面的那个是元始天尊，灵宝天尊，和道德天尊。”
“拿着白拂尘的那一个？”
“那个是道德天尊，就是太上老君。老滑头一个，最会见风使舵。他说的话都只可信一半。”
“那边是南方南极观音，东方崇恩圣帝，另外三个似乎是为了镇压肆虐的妖魔没有来。”
“啊？观音菩萨！”
花千骨仰望端坐紫金莲的救苦救难的菩萨，差点没想跪下去拜两拜。
却见观音周身都是祥瑞，眉目间大慈大悲，一片微微的圣洁白光中，不断变幻的脸孔让人看不真切，却让花千骨想起未见过面的苦命的娘，突然内心一片酸楚。

content_en:
"Ah, what?" Sugar Baby climbed into a peach blossom and licked the fairy juice inside, feeling dizzy with the sweetness.
"I can touch the flower! I can touch the flower!! It's not withered, not at all!" Hua Qiangu suddenly reacted. With trembling legs, she hugged the petals in front of her that were huge compared to its fleshy body. She rubbed her face against it. The soft peach petals were as smooth and beautiful as silk. Hua Qiangu rolled around excitedly and wrapped herself up like a petal quilt. It smelled so good and felt so comfortable.
"Weren't you able to touch flowers before?"
"Of course, otherwise why would I be called Hua Qiangu? I was born to be the nemesis of flowers. There has never been a flower that can remain intact in my hands. Why? Why?"
"I think it's related to the Tianshui Drop or the Magatama. Especially the Magatama, which seems ordinary, but has spiritual power many times stronger than the Tianshui Drop. You originally had a smell that attracted monsters and monsters, but it was all blocked by that."
"Ah? No wonder since I separated from Brother Lang, there aren't as many annoying brats bothering me anymore!" Hua Qiangu happily climbed from one flower to another.
There were gradually more and more people in the forest, and the table was filled with nectar, jade liquid, fairy fruits and delicacies, which made Tang Bao almost salivate.
"Do you think I would be discovered if I jumped onto the peaches on the table below?"
"Not only will they be discovered, but they might also be eaten by the immortals." Hua Qiangu laughed loudly, "How many immortals are going to come? Why are there so many seats?"
"There are many famous and unknown immortals in the world, but not many can attend the heavenly banquet. Most of the powerful Taoists are here. In addition to the heads of various immortal sects who are bound to come, the Queen Mother will also send invitations to some well-known loose immortals. Now Kunlun is in charge of the Queen Mother. In total, there are about four to five hundred people coming."
After a while, the bells rang loudly, the fairy music played loudly, and the immortals entered the venue and began to take their seats.
There were all kinds of immortals, including otherworldly ones, stunningly beautiful ones, fairy-like ones, senile ones, and vicious ones. For a time, Hua Qiangu was dazzled and his mouth was dry. Except for the fact that the Jade Emperor and Queen Mother are sitting at the top, no one else is known.
Sugar Baby introduced her one by one.
"Sitting over there are the three immortals of Penglai, the three stars of fortune, wealth and longevity. Wearing red clothes and having a mustache, they are staring at the fairies. The one with a lewd smile is the God of Wealth. The one next to him is the God of Fortune. The one with his head buried in a cup is the God of Fortune. His beard and hair are all white. The one with a boy standing next to him is the longevity star, the Antarctic Immortal."
"Over there are the leaders of Laoshan, Tianshan, Taibaishan, Wangwushan and other sects. It's a pity that Taoist Master Qingxu of Maoshan is no longer here..."
"Who is the leader of Laoshan?" Hua Qiangu stretched her neck to look. She wanted to help Lin Suiran deliver a message to his master.
"Under that tree over there, you see the one with white hair, brows furrowed and eyes closed, sitting quietly?"
"Oh, I saw it!"
"Well, those over there should be easy to recognize. Most of them are Buddhist Bodhisattvas. The ones on the left with plain clothes and bald heads are the Eighteen Arhats. A little further back are the Eighteen Arhats such as Meiyin, Sanskrit, Tiangu, Song De, Guangmu, etc. Pay attention to Miao Tan. She is the most beautiful one, competing with Chang'e. The strangest looking one is Lei Yin."
"The tables further to the east are the Twenty Heavens. Their immortal skills are all top-notch and their tempers are quite hot. Most people don't dare to provoke them too much."
"The people playing chess over there are the Six Stars of the South Dipper and the Seven Stars of the Big Dipper. Thirteen people get together, and every time they have the opportunity to get together, they play chess day and night, and it is a super alliance melee that thirteen people play at the same time. Their chess pieces are all stars in the sky, and they can train the best weapons in the world."
"The other person making a loud noise, as if they were quarreling, is the Dragon King of the Four Seas."
"Huh? There is actually a woman?So beautiful! "Hua Qiangu looked at the faces of so many shocking celestial beings, and began to feel a little tired of aesthetic appreciation, but she was still amazed by the red-haired Dragon King who laughed heartily and still maintained the charming posture of a woman.
"Well, the most drinkable, powerful, and beautiful one among them is the newly appointed Dragon King of the North Sea. "
“The ones in front are Yuanshi Tianzun, Lingbao Tianzun, and Daode Tianzun. "
"The one with the white whisk? "
“That is the Daode Tianzun, Taishang Laojun. A cunning old man who knows how to maneuver according to the wind. Everything he said was only half credible. "
"Over there is Guanyin in the South and Saint Emperor Chong'en in the East. The other three seem to have not come to suppress the raging demons. "
"ah? Guanyin Bodhisattva! "
Hua Qiangu looked up at the rescuing Bodhisattva sitting on the purple golden lotus, and almost didn't want to kneel down and worship twice.
However, he saw that Guanyin's body was full of auspiciousness, her brows were filled with compassion, and in a faint holy white light, her ever-changing face made it difficult to see clearly, but it reminded Hua Qiangu of her miserable mother whom she had never met before, and suddenly her heart felt sad.
